_comment: Hand-labeled backtest set (brief: 'Validation step — backtest before charging for it'). Real Base mainnet wallets pulled from merchant_signals after a live BazaarDataSource refresh on 2026-08-10 — not fabricated. Schema is {wallet, expectedTier} pairs rather than fixed trusted/avoid arrays so caution examples can be included honestly.
_avoid_bucket: Deliberately empty. Bazaar (our only real data source right now) is a directory of registered, legitimate-enough-to-list services, not a scam registry — it has no examples of established bad actors. Labeling a thin-history wallet 'avoid' would be wrong ground truth: our own scoring.ts already classifies thin history as 'caution' (insufficient data), not 'avoid' (reserved for multiple red flags on an established wallet). Fill this in once a genuine x402-specific bad-actor source exists, or enough real usage data accumulates to observe one (see brief's roadmap: 'trained model once there's enough labeled outcome data').
